Keywords run in the last 24 hours are reused at no search cost.

parameters.jsCode:
// Listing rows from new searches only (reused pages are already saved, so nothing is written twice)
return $('Toolkit Core').first().json.listings.map(json => ({ json }));

// One item per product page to look up (1 SerpApi search each). Products looked up in the last 24 h are reused instead.
return $('Rank Competitors').first().json.lookups.map(json => ({ json }));

parameters.content:
## i3 · Competitor Targeting
2-5 related keywords → page 1 of each (reused if saved in the last 24 h) → shared Toolkit Core groups variations → competitors merged across keywords → ranked by relevance → top 8 looked up (BSR, seller, real brand) → each judged as an ad target against your product. No AI: every word of every reason comes from a number.

## One competitor, one row
Same ASIN on two pages, or same brand + same shared review count + same rating = one competitor. Its sales are the HIGHEST badge across pages, never the sum.

Relevance = keywords it ranks on (50) + best position (30) + share of page sales (20).

## Weak spots (m19 ASIN-targeting practice)
Priced 5%+ above you · rated lower than you (or under 4.0★) · fewer reviews than you (or under 1,000) · 15%+ of ratings 1-2★.
High = relevance 50+ and 2+ weak spots. Medium = 50+ and 1, or 30+ and 2+. Else Low.

## Search cost
New page: 1 search per keyword not saved in 24 h. Lookups: up to 8, minus any product looked up in the last 24 h (Products tab). Both IF nodes skip the SerpApi node entirely when nothing is needed.
